name: benchmark-agent
description: One general-purpose /benchmark skill backed by a native engine: plan, run (sync or detached), tune, analyze, compare and track experiments on any system with fair comparison, a required-params gate, resource/OOM guardrails, a loop-guarded tuner and honest reports. Benchmark anything via the generic CommandDomain (shell-stage DAG) or a Python Domain; an awareness hook loads prior context transparently.
